units.source_text: 匂亲王知道大女公子七七之期还有数日未满，

en.t: Prince Niou knew that several days still remained before the forty ninth day memorial for the elder lady,

units.source_text: 但因思念二女公子不胜其苦，便不顾风雪寒威，半夜里赶到宇治来。

en.t: but his longing for the second lady was so painful that he ignored the bitter wind and snow and hurried to Uji in the middle of the night.

units.source_text: 这诚意应可抵偿近月来疏慢之恶，然而二女公子不肯和他见面。

en.t: Such devotion might have made up for his neglect in recent months, yet the second lady refused to see him.

units.source_text: 因为她想起姐姐为此人而忧愤成疾，深感耻辱。

en.t: For she remembered how her elder sister had fallen ill from grief and anger over this man, and she felt deeply ashamed.

units.source_text: 姐姐不曾看见此人回心转意，就此死去，今后即使此人改过自新，亦无补于事了。

en.t: Her sister had died without seeing him change his heart, so even if he reformed himself now, it could no longer help anything.

units.source_text: 众侍女都来劝请，说理应接见。

en.t: All the ladies in waiting came to urge her, saying that she ought properly to receive him.

units.source_text: 二女公子才答应隔着屏障晤谈。

en.t: Only then did the second lady agree to speak with him from behind a screen.

units.source_text: 匂亲王向她诉说月来怠慢的原因，言语滔滔不绝。

en.t: Prince Niou explained to her the reasons for his neglect over the past months, speaking on and on without end.

units.source_text: 二女公子茫茫然地听他说。

en.t: The second lady listened to him in a daze.

units.source_text: 匂亲王看见此人也已奄奄一息，深恐她将步姐姐后尘，

en.t: Seeing that she too seemed close to death, Prince Niou feared deeply that she would follow her sister's fate,

units.source_text: 觉得非常抱歉，又很担心。

en.t: and he felt terribly sorry and very anxious.

units.source_text: 他今天是不顾母后将来谴责，拼着性命而来的。

en.t: Today he had come at the risk of his life, disregarding the reproaches his mother might later make.

units.source_text: 因此苦苦请求：“撤去屏障吧。”

en.t: So he pleaded desperately, "Please take away the screen."

units.source_text: 二女公子只答一语：“且待我神志清醒些……”

en.t: The second lady answered only one thing: "Wait until my mind is a little clearer..."

units.source_text: 终不肯和他对面。

en.t: In the end, she still would not face him directly.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言闻此情状，召唤几个解事的侍女来前，对她们说：

en.t: When Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, heard of the situation, he summoned several sensible ladies in waiting and said to them:

units.source_text: “匂亲王违背初心，近几月来态度冷淡，固然罪无可逭，难怪二小姐怨恨。

en.t: "Prince Niou betrayed his first intentions and has been cold these past few months, so his fault is certainly hard to excuse, and it is no wonder the second young lady resents him.

units.source_text: 但惩诫亦有限度，不可过分伤情。

en.t: But even punishment has its limits, and she must not wound him too deeply.

units.source_text: 匂亲王不曾受过如此冷遇，定然非常痛苦。”

en.t: Prince Niou has never been treated so coldly before, and he must be suffering greatly."

units.source_text: 他私下叫侍女去向二女公子劝说。

en.t: He privately sent the ladies in waiting to persuade the second lady.

units.source_text: 二女公子闻之，觉得此人也如此用心，叫我越发可耻了，便置之不答。

en.t: When the second lady heard this, she felt that even Kaoru's concern only made her shame greater, and she left it unanswered.

units.source_text: 匂亲王说：“如此待我，实太无情。

en.t: Prince Niou said, "To treat me like this is truly too heartless.

units.source_text: 从前的山盟海誓都忘记了！”

en.t: Have you forgotten all the solemn vows we made before?"

units.source_text: 他频频叹息，空度时光。

en.t: He sighed again and again, passing the time in vain.

units.source_text: 此时夜色凄凉，风声惨烈。

en.t: At that moment the night looked desolate, and the sound of the wind was harsh and mournful.

units.source_text: 他唉声叹气地独自躺着，虽是自作自受，毕竟也很可怜。

en.t: He lay there alone, sighing over and over; though he had brought it on himself, he was still pitiable.

units.source_text: 二女公子便又隔着屏障和他晤谈。

en.t: So the second lady spoke with him again from behind the screen.

units.source_text: 匂亲王向诸佛菩萨赌咒起誓，保证永远不变初心。

en.t: Prince Niou swore by all the Buddhas and bodhisattvas, promising that he would never change his heart again.

units.source_text: 二女公子想：“他怎么会顺口说出这一大套话来？”

en.t: The second lady thought, "How can he so easily pour out such a flood of words?"

units.source_text: 反而觉得讨厌。

en.t: Instead, she found it distasteful.

units.source_text: 但她此时心情，和恨别伤离时有所不同。

en.t: Yet her feelings at this moment were different from when she had hated parting and grieved over separation.

units.source_text: 看到匂亲王那可怜的模样，心肠自然发软，不能漠然地不睬他了。

en.t: Seeing Prince Niou's pitiful state, her heart naturally softened, and she could no longer ignore him coldly.

units.source_text: 她茫茫然地听了一会，隐隐约约地念一首诗：

en.t: She listened vaguely for a while, then faintly recited a poem:
